principles.name: Find the golden zone
principles.who: Wide players and midfielders in the final third

summary.standard: In the final third, look for the space in front of their box, and from near the end line pull the ball back low toward the penalty spot.
summary.kid: At the end line, pull it back to the penalty spot.

principles.ruleOfThumb: Our own value surface is highest in the space in front of their box and around the penalty spot (default). A pull-back from within about 17 m of the end line to a teammate near the middle scores highest (default); the golden zone yields about half of the shots and 82 % of the goals (sourced).

why.standard: A ball pulled back from the end line reaches a teammate facing goal while the defenders are running toward their own goal.
why.kid: Pull the ball back from the end line. Your teammate runs in facing goal. Their defenders are running the wrong way.

principles.commonMistake: Crossing high into a crowded box when a teammate is free at the edge of it.

principles.name: Long passes need a clear lane

summary.standard: The risk of a pass grows with its length and flight time, so play a long pass only when its lane is wide open.
summary.kid: Long passes are hard. Play them only when wide open.

principles.ruleOfThumb: A youth ground pass is accurate about 96 % of the time at 25 m, 78 % at 40 m and 50 % at 50 m (defaults); below 85 %, about 34 m, the engine calls it a long pass.

why.standard: A long pass gives defenders more time to get across and is harder to play accurately, so more long passes are lost.
why.kid: A long pass takes longer to arrive and is harder to hit. Their defenders get time to run across. More long passes are lost.

principles.commonMistake: Hitting a long ball to a distant teammate when a short, safe pass was on.

principles.name: Keep the ball when nothing is on

summary.standard: When no forward pass is on, keep possession with a safe pass sideways or back, then look to switch or go forward again.
summary.kid: Nothing forward? Keep the ball and look again.

principles.ruleOfThumb: When the best pass is a safe square or back pass and no good forward pass scores within 10 points of it (default), keeping the ball is right and grades as the best pass.

why.standard: Losing the ball with a forced forward pass is worse than keeping it and trying again a moment later.
why.kid: A forced forward pass that loses the ball is worse than keeping it. Keep it, and try again a moment later.

principles.commonMistake: Forcing a pass forward into a crowd when a simple pass back would keep the ball.

principles.name: Pass through a third player

summary.standard: When the pass to a runner is blocked, play it to a teammate who lays it off first time to the runner arriving on the defender's blind side.
summary.kid: Blocked? Pass to a friend who can set it up.

principles.ruleOfThumb: From v2 the engine rates two passes in a row: the first must be safe, and the second is rated from the middle player's spot with the defenders a step behind. The combination is worth 0.9 of the two passes' value (default).

why.standard: Defenders watch the ball and the first receiver, so the third player arrives unmarked.
why.kid: Defenders watch the ball and the first teammate near it. The third player arrives with nobody watching.

principles.commonMistake: Waiting for the direct pass to the runner to open instead of using a nearby teammate.

principles.name: Draw the defender, then pass

summary.standard: In a two-against-one, carry the ball at the defender until they commit to you, then release the pass to your free teammate.
summary.kid: Two of you, one of them? Draw them, then pass.

principles.ruleOfThumb: Needs a carry option and timing, planned for v2: pass when the defender steps toward you and is within about 3 m (default).

why.standard: Once the defender commits to the ball, your teammate is free and cannot be caught in time.
why.kid: Once the defender goes for the ball, they cannot catch your teammate. Play the pass right then.

principles.commonMistake: Passing too early, so the defender can simply move across to your teammate.
